steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.

title: REVBRAIN: Real-time Probabilistic EEG Forecasting Using Residual Vector Quantization
summary: REVBRAIN replaces sample-by-sample autoregressive WaveNet inference for probabilistic EEG forecasting with residual-vector-quantization tokenization that generates the entire 200 ms prediction horizon in a single forward pass. The cost is a tokenization stage that discretizes the output space, adding pipeline complexity and quantization error, and the reported accuracy advantage is limited to one EEG forecasting benchmark. The method can fail if the RVQ codebook underrepresents signal regimes outside the resting-state alpha band used in evaluation, and the probabilistic calibration of tokenized forecasts remains unverified for closed-loop stimulation settings.
rationale: The technique is specific to real-time EEG/BCI forecasting rather than general ML serving, so it is relevant only if the reader works on neural time-series prediction, but the RVQ-based parallel decoding pattern is worth tracking as an approach to autoregressive latency bottlenecks.
technique: RVQ tokenization for non-autoregressive time-series forecasting

claims.statement: REVBRAIN replaces sample-by-sample autoregressive WaveNet inference for probabilistic EEG forecasting with residual-vector-quantization tokenization that generates the entire 200 ms prediction horizon in a single forward pass. The cost is a tokenization stage that discretizes the output space, adding pipeline complexity and quantization error, and the reported accuracy advantage is limited to one EEG forecasting benchmark. The method can fail if the RVQ codebook underrepresents signal regimes outside the resting-state alpha band used in evaluation, and the probabilistic calibration of tokenized forecasts remains unverified for closed-loop stimulation settings.
REVBRAIN achieved real-time inference on a laptop GPU with over 50x speedup compared to WaveNet, while reporting superior prediction accuracy on 200 ms alpha-band EEG forecasting.
